subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

To avoid ___________ on the roads, proper signs and signals should be put up.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e.** 'congestion'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• In this context the given sentence implies that to avoid something proper signs and signals should be displayed.
 
• **Congestion : (अत्यधिक भीड़ होने की अवस्था**) - The state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people.
 
 
• **Example:** There is always congestion in the city during rush hour.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'congestion' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the complete sentence is *"**To avoid congestion__ on the roads, proper signs and signals should be put up."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sleeping : (सोना) **- The state of being asleep.

 
 
• **Example: **She was sleeping peacefully.
 
 
 
• **Stuffing : (भरना)** - The material used to fill something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was stuffing the pillow with cotton.
 
 
 
• **Chuffing : (क्षुभित करना) **- British informal term, used for emphasis as a mild form of annoyance or pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** He was chuffing away on his cigar. Note: Usage depends on the region and context.
